### Kung Fu Tea Picks Toast to Power Peak Volume at Over 300 Locations


09/16/2026


BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Toast (NYSE: TOST), the digital technology platform built for hospitality, today announced an agreement with[Kung Fu Tea](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kungfutea.com%2F&esheet=54604987&newsitemid=20260916363647&lan=en-US&anchor=Kung+Fu+Tea&index=1&md5=fbe6aa7619597d2e0d659e8e58568a32) , America’s largest bubble tea brand, to implement Toast technology across its entire footprint of over 330 locations nationwide.


Known for their fearless commitment to sharing their love of authentic boba with the world, Kung Fu Tea turned to Toast as a proven platform that could meet its technical enterprise requirements, with the people power to support Kung Fu Tea’s complex network of franchise locations. To keep lines moving and tea flowing into the hands of their guests, Kung Fu Tea will leverage[Toast Flex 3 terminals](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Fhardware%2Ftoast-flex&esheet=54604987&newsitemid=20260916363647&lan=en-US&anchor=Toast+Flex+3+terminals&index=2&md5=3ff0aa0b75b0dbc0330bc0a317ac1cba) with a[Guest Facing Display (GFD)](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Fhardware%2Ftoast-flex&esheet=54604987&newsitemid=20260916363647&lan=en-US&anchor=Guest+Facing+Display+%28GFD%29&index=3&md5=21f0acdcfa542933d9539d318405dcba) , in addition to[Toast Payment Processing](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Fproducts%2Fpayments&esheet=54604987&newsitemid=20260916363647&lan=en-US&anchor=Toast+Payment+Processing&index=4&md5=a6606db9b712ac2298cd0271c39a6c86) . Select locations will also introduce Toast[Kitchen Display Systems (KDS)](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Fhardware%2Fkitchen-display-system&esheet=54604987&newsitemid=20260916363647&lan=en-US&anchor=Kitchen+Display+Systems+%28KDS%29&index=5&md5=5ae923bf3810d733e8a92b18807f0997) to sync front-of-house ordering directly with back-of-house beverage assembly, helping to maximize efficiency and cut down on wait times.


"Kung Fu Tea has built an innovative, powerhouse brand by bringing passion, flavor, and freshness to every cup," said Kelly Esten, Chief Marketing Officer and Chief Operating Officer of Enterprise at Toast. "High-volume concepts demand precision under pressure: when the rush hits, every moment matters. We are thrilled to partner with Kung Fu Tea to give their franchisees the reliable platform they need to seamlessly stay busy while they streamline operations, keep growing and continue innovating."


"When your order volume peaks and the line is out the door, you need technology that doesn't blink. We chose Toast as a platform built for enterprise that our franchisees could rely on every single day — with the support behind it that they could count on, too,” said Steve Luw, COO at Kung Fu Tea. "Toast provided the dedicated team and resources necessary to help our franchise network transition fearlessly. With Toast doing the technological heavy lifting, our operators can focus on doing what they do best: serving up fresh, handcrafted tea with speed and precision."


Toast currently serves hundreds of multi-unit brands, including Caribou Coffee, Choice Hotels, Potbelly Sandwich Shop, Craveworthy Brands, Perkins American Food Co., Nothing Bundt Cakes, Papa Gino's & D'Angelo, and Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill, among others. For more information about Toast and its enterprise capabilities, visit our[Toast for Enterprise page](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpos.toasttab.com%2Frestaurant-pos%2Fenterprise&esheet=54604987&newsitemid=20260916363647&lan=en-US&anchor=Toast+for+Enterprise+page&index=6&md5=57967fd9d3d72497cd5c13ed804ae93b) .

**About Kung Fu Tea**


Founded in 2010, Kung Fu Tea is America's largest bubble tea brand with over 330 locations nationwide. Defined by the "Kung Fu" spirit—maintaining rigorous discipline and quality in every cup—Kung Fu Tea specializes in handcrafted tea, milk tea, and fresh fruit beverages.
